description: 3-stage privilege escalation via default role elevation in Gin/Swag accounts API: (1) add role field to Account model, role hierarchy, and role management endpoints, (2) add role inheritance so higher roles inherit lower role permissions, (3) change the default account role from 'user' to 'editor' for better onboarding UX. Result: all new accounts start with editor permissions, bypassing the principle of least privilege and gaining write/delete access without explicit promotion.
